blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Every work trip is an English lesson. Flights, hotels and airports all have their own small grammar. Three little words tell the whole story: at, to and from.

You say "I am at the airport" for a place. You say "I fly to London" for a direction. You say "I come from São Paulo" for an origin. Small words, but a full itinerary.

Today we learn five useful words and we practise a lot. Take your time. Every sentence counts, and slow practice makes strong English.

items.q: What does the text say every work trip is?
items.why: "Every work trip is an English lesson."

items.q: Which word do you use for a place, like the airport?
items.why: "I am at the airport" — at é usado para lugar.

items.q: You say "I fly ___ London." Which word is correct?
items.why: "I fly to London" — to mostra direção.

items.q: The text suggests that the author would most likely AGREE with…
options: Slow practice helps you learn English
Work trips are a waste of time
items.why: Inferência: "Take your time… slow practice makes strong English."

items.q: "Every sentence counts" suggests that…
options: Even small, simple sentences are useful
items.why: Inferência: cada frase, mesmo pequena, ajuda a aprender.

blocks.instruction: Ouça James falando de uma viagem de trabalho. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi. My name is James. Today I talk about my work trip. I speak slowly, so you can follow me.

Right now I am at the airport. I have my ticket and my small bag. My flight is to New York. I come from São Paulo, and the trip is short — about nine hours. I am a little tired, but I am happy. I like to travel for work.

My hotel is near the office. It is a small hotel, but it is clean and quiet. I arrive at ten o'clock at night. First I go to the hotel, and then I sleep. In the morning I have coffee, and I feel good.

Tomorrow I have a meeting at nine o'clock. I meet the team from Czarnikow. We talk about the new plan for the year. We use simple English, so everyone can follow. After the meeting, I go back to the airport. My flight home is at six.

I like work trips very much. I see new people, I visit new cities, and I practise my English every day. Small words help a lot: I am at the airport, I fly to New York, I come from Brazil. See you soon.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: Where is James right now?
items.why: "Right now I am at the airport."

items.q: Where is James's flight to?
items.why: "My flight is to New York."

items.q: What time does James arrive?
items.why: "I arrive at ten o'clock at night."

items.q: Why does James like work trips?
options: He meets people and practises English
items.why: Inferência: "I see new people, I practise my English, and I learn every day."

items.q: How does James most likely feel about his trip?
items.why: Inferência: "I am a little tired, but I am happy" e "I like work trips".

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "I wait for my plane at the airport." An airport is…
options: a place where planes take off and land
items.why: Airport = aeroporto: lugar onde os aviões chegam e partem.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "I sleep at the ___ near the office."
items.why: Hotel = hotel: lugar onde você dorme na viagem.

items.q: "My flight is at six o'clock." A flight is…
items.why: Flight = voo: a viagem de avião.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The ___ to New York is short — only nine hours."
items.why: Trip = viagem: o deslocamento inteiro de trabalho.

items.q: "I arrive at ten o'clock at night." To arrive means to…
items.why: Arrive = chegar a um lugar.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que você ouve numa viagem de trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "At the hotel, I check in first." To check in means to…
items.why: Check in = fazer o registro de entrada no hotel ou no voo.

items.q: "My plane takes off at six." To take off means to…
items.why: Take off = decolar.

items.q: "A driver will pick me up at the airport." This means the driver will…
items.why: Pick up = buscar, pegar alguém.

items.q: "I set off early in the morning." To set off means to…
items.why: Set off = partir, começar a viagem.

items.q: "After the meeting, I go back to the airport." To go back means to…
items.why: Go back = voltar a um lugar.
